fragments.text: Good day ladies and gentlemen, I will be dealing with a topic governing AI, balancing freedom of expression and information accessibility. Ladies and gentlemen, esteemed guests and fellow attendees of the AI4AI or IA 2023 conference, I am Dr. Ricardo Neal and I bring a wealth of experience in terms of information, technology and management. I am deeply honored to address you today on the topic of immense importance within our digital age that we live in, the governance of artificial intelligence. Specifically, we will explore the intricacies and the balances between freedom of expression and information accessibility. In addition to my doctorate of science and information and knowledge and management, I am also the founder of the St.Kiss and Limits Robotics Association, the CEO of IIT AEMTB,

which is a technological firm and hold an extreme position as professor of information technology and conduct a science tool among other courses. Furthermore, I am an active participant in the first mobile robotics Olympics where we witness first-hand the remarkable potential of technology across the world and also by extension the Caribbean. Artificial intelligence or AI has woven itself into the fabric of our daily lives, revolutionizing the way we produce, consume and interact with information. It has the power to transform industries, drive economic and provide new solutions to age-old problems. Yet, this information forces it not with all its complexity. AI in all its marvel present us with a paradox. On one hand, it enhances information

accessibility, providing personal content and improving search results. On the other hand, it challenges the principles of freedom of expression and information accessibility in ways we have never seen before. Before we delve further, it's clarify, let's clarify rather our concepts. Freedom of expression is a cornerstone of democratic societies, ensuring individuals rights to voice their opinion, thoughts and belief without censorship, information accessibility and the other hand referred to the ability of individuals to access and share information freely, creating a vibrant information society. In an ideal world, the principles would coexist harmoniously, but in the digital era tensions have emerged as AI interacts with these fundamental values. The governance of AI is not a simple task. It involves addressing challenges such as algorithmic biases, content moderation.
